title: Length-aware rollout lane allocation
description: A 1:1 submission mix becomes completion-skewed when short requests turn over faster. Length-aware lane allocation restores a 1:1 completion mix at barrier B=12. Dark blocks are completed; pale blocks are still active at the barrier frontier. Each case also has a bucket projection linked by request identity.

checkpoints.label: Case 1: 1:1 sampling at submission
checkpoints.narrative: A 1:1 submission mix is not a 1:1 completion mix: short requests turn over faster, so the first 12 completions contain 9 short and 3 long requests. Open the Case 1 buckets tab to verify the same requests grouped by request_kind.

checkpoints.label: Case 2: Length-aware: 2 short + 6 long lanes
checkpoints.narrative: Allocate 2 lanes to short requests and 6 lanes to long requests to account for different chunk lengths. The first 12 completions now contain 6 short and 6 long requests. Open the Case 2 buckets tab to inspect the corresponding request identities.
